data.title: New whales account for one-third of Bitcoin's whale realized cap
data.description: Bitcoin's ownership map is being redrawn in real time. A CryptoQuant report published October 16, 2026, authored by analyst MorenoDV_, found that new whales now hold $78.61 billion in realized cap, representing 33.06% of the total whale realized cap.
